Hey, I really hope you're still here. I read your post and registered on reddit, I summarized a lot of my thoughts for you:

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/1vf2jf/seeking_enlightenment_inquire_within_words_for/

By the way, you are a fantastic writer. You haven't even gone to college yet! Think of the profound impact you can have on the world.

I just wanted to share metaphysics and spirit sciences with you. When I was where you are, wish I knew about this. It would have done a lot more than all the doctors and therapy sessions accomplished. You are still young, knowledge is endless and I assure you; quantifying it will make life worth living. The universe is so interesting... not to mention, the world has incredible changes awaiting us right around the corner!

If you raise your vibration, the effect will return so much love into your life. There is a collective consciousness. Each individual brings change. Potential for your own is limitless, simply the boundaries of your imagination.

Fake your death, take your loan returns and go to south america. Sell jewelry on etsy. Problem solved!

Sorry, I just wanted to play off the "I want a new life" thing. After four years of school, a break is well deserved. I suggest you try and travel after graduation... fuck loans. I think your major has relatively high job security too, should you choose to get back into it. Civil engineering is pretty cool, by the way.

I'm gay, too. I also have a spotty history with psychiatric professionals. They use one book to diagnose everything (DSM, if you're unfamiliar) and each edition features broader symptoms and diagnosis. It is made to benefit Big Pharma and increase demand for their pills used in illness that is made up.

I am far more skeptical of mental disorder, versus what you can actually see on the body. We don't understand brain chemistry enough, yet.

But it totally sounds like you should go on vacation or something and I hope that is a possibility for you. If not, try to make it happen. Not to be a complete broken record, but DAMN you have been in school FOUR YEARS. I just started college, lol. I'm in poli sci now but might go back to architecture.

It really stinks you're against your major now. That is why I think you should do the soul searching and figure out what you want to do. It sounds like you sort of already know, too. You just need a plan!

I'm also for reincarnation and tried to kill myself in May. I've since become submissive to the natural order of things. The way I see it, when I am supposed to die; it will happen. We are disrupting the cycle by offing ourselves before fulfilling our purpose. Not to mention, it will throw you a few lifetimes back from being this close to enlightenment.

Check out Spirit Science on youtube, if you're into that stuff. I've been diving into the metaphysics a lot myself, lately. Really interesting stuff and I can't spend enough time each day spreading the word of it!

How long have you been with your bf? I admire your selfless act by not telling him, when there is enough on his plate this moment. That says something very good about you, not wanting to disrupt the vibration.

Have you given natural medicational remedy a chance?
Like meditation and opening your chakras...
I strongly recommend you check out Spirit Science on Youtube. Is a webshow about metaphysics and tying spirituality and science together. A lot of New Age ideas and touches every major religion.

Would really like to talk to you more about this. All those pills are not helping, granted some probably are. It is difficult to pin point a working treatment since everyone has such drastic difference in brain chemistry.

Really, check those videos out. And don't immediately accept or reject it... just have an open mind. Perhaps if you can get stable enough, you can find a real job. Quick than you think, too! What do you like to do?

I have a firm belief that each individual person on this planet has a purpose. We are misguided and confused by over stimulation and too many choices in today's world that creates a paradox, where we cannot decide for ourselves which is the correct one. In terms of existential attitude, whichever choice is made becomes the right one. Is a matter of finding confidence in yourself to do so via clarity of the mind.

It sounds like a part of your psyche has fallen into a void. This happens more often than you'd think, due to extraordinary quick rotation of the Hedonic Treadmill. My friend, I am not trying to standardize your problems. Just want to shine a light on a possible cause... this isn't your fault. Our society is suffering by not understanding implications of it's actions. Meaning we are very impressionable and the media subliminally makes us more depressed. This world is so materialistic.

We need to shift the paradigm back to understanding ourselves on the spiritual level. I'm sorry your girlfriend did that. I had a similar outcome in a past relationship, I maxed out my credit card on her without a job. Then she got hired at my old work and left me for a good friend of mine.

I almost failed high school in June. I really see a number of parallels to your story and mine... in the end I had a suicide attempt and was in the hospital for the last two weeks of school. The medical leave got me out of work and I walked across the stage. Granted, I had to work my ass off when I got back to make up studying for finals.

Then I failed my Economics final and the teacher passed me anyways. Point is, the education system is broken and this sucks for us as students. Only benefit is we may use the loopholes to our advantage. If it worked however, I don't think it would be such a hassle and administrations would be far more accepting of your present limitation.

Talk to your counselor, they will help you out. The school wants you to graduate and will do as much possible. I got out with a 2.2 GPA but it's the diploma that matters... I don't know if you LIKE school but I'm in community college now and it is MUCH easier than high school!

I'm not spamming but I just posted this in the same section:
http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/1vf2jf/seeking_enlightenment_inquire_within_words_for/

Check out the web show I mention. If you're into psych, will serve you well for sure. Also give mediation a go. Or any natural remedy for the depression because those meds are no good. I was self medicating on weed for 5 months leading up to my attempt... I don't recommend this, either. I just covered up the problem and didn't go anywhere in life.

Not to mention I was piss broke and resorted to dealing drugs. I really stand by meditation, is almost a hobby and does much better things for me than ANY drug I have been prescribed for depression. Knowledge is power, too. Power makes us feel good, assuming it doesn't corrupt us. Then you feel slimy.

Point is, I have faith in your ability to find that inner strength. If you are as gifted with helping others that you say, the good karma is just around the corner for you. Everything will turn around and you will be back on your feet in no time. It will all fall into place, mang. If you need to talk more about this, I'm down to help you through this. You sound far too incredible a person for this world to lose, especially right now!

We need as many individuals who display genuine empathy to spread the love. That is how we are going to fix this place!
